messages:
nora_customer: Hey team — seeing a weird bug where tool outputs get swapped between parallel tool calls. Request ID 01GZhil2, trace 9a2f3. I call two tools in the same function invocation: `web_search` and `summarizer`. The response payload shows `web_search` returning a short summary and `summarizer` returning raw HTML.

Aisha (support): Thanks for reporting — can you paste the raw request you sent and the server response you received? Any correlation ids / logs you can share will help.

nora_customer: Pasting minimal repro. Note the tool_calls array has two entries and both include a call_uuid we generated client-side:

```
POST /v1/function_call
{
  "request_id": "01GZhil2",
  "tool_calls": [
    {"name": "web_search", "args": {"q": "redwood inference"}, "call_uuid": "call-1"},
    {"name": "summarizer", "args": {"len": 200}, "call_uuid": "call-2"}
  ]
}
```

Server response snippet we got back:

```
{
  "request_id": "01GZhil2",
  "tool_results": [
    {"call_uuid": "call-1", "result": "Short summary text..."},
    {"call_uuid": "call-2", "result": "<html>...full page html...</html>"}
  ]
}
```

But when we surface it to user the UI shows the summary under the summarizer call and HTML under search. Logs (redacted) show the router mapping tool_results to tools using the call_uuid, but timestamps indicate responses arrived out-of-order.

Aisha (support): Escalating to eng. @marco_runtime can you take a look? @priya_infra for routing traces.

marco_runtime: Looking. Quick question: Is your client SDK set to batch or parallel mode? Also, can you share the exact SDK version? Hunch: the association code ties responses by `call_uuid` but if client accidentally reuses a UUID or there is a race the router might mis-associate.

nora_customer: SDK v0.8.3, parallel mode enabled. I confirmed we generated unique call-1 / call-2 in our codepath — but I can also repro with a tight loop.

priya_infra: Pulled router logs for trace 9a2f3. Two tool backend responses arrived at: 2026-03-17T16:12:05.123Z (summarizer) and 2026-03-17T16:12:05.127Z (web_search). Router matched both by `request_id` + `call_uuid` string. However, I see `call_uuid` present as `call-1` for both responses in one of the internal logs — looks like the client library reuses the same nonce under high parallelism.

sam_qa: I reproduced locally with a small script. Curl example to trigger the bug:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/function_call \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"request_id":"test-req","tool_calls":[{"name":"web_search","call_uuid":"c"},{"name":"summarizer","call_uuid":"c"}]}'
```

That returns two tool_results but both claim `call_uuid":"c"` and mapping becomes ambiguous.

marco_runtime: Found root cause: client SDK's UUID generator used a non-atomic increment on a shared buffer when parallelizing requests in the same process, leading to duplicated `call_uuid` values for different subcalls. Router code assumed uniqueness and used string match only. Patch plan: 1) server-side fallback: if duplicate call_uuid detected, use subcall arrival order + tool name signature to disambiguate; 2) push client patch to v0.8.4 that fixes the UUID generator.

aisha_support: Workarounds we can offer: update client to 0.8.4 when available OR set `serialize_tool_calls=true` in the function call options to force sequential subcalls (will have latency cost). I'll send both options to the customer.

marco_runtime: Preparing hotfix for router to be defensive. PR #3832 adds a server-assigned `subcall_id` when client `call_uuid` collisions are detected and improves logs to include `subcall_sequence`. Will run in staging first.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: staging/router v2.14.1-hotfix-3832 :construction:

priya_infra: Staging run looks good under load test (10k parallel tool subcalls). No mis-associations observed after fallback in place. Monitoring dash added to track `call_uuid` duplicates.

marco_runtime: Fix merged to main and scheduled for canary deploy to production tonight. Root cause summary: client nonce reuse under tight parallel loops + router assumption of uniqueness. Long-term: we'll add server-side unique subcall ids into the RPC negotiation to avoid relying solely on client-generated identifiers.

aisha_support: Thanks everyone — @nora_customer can you try the workaround (serialize=true) or pick latest client once 0.8.4 is out and confirm? Really appreciate the repro steps you sent :pray: 

nora_customer: Tried serialize=true — responses are now correctly associated. Will update to client 0.8.4 when it lands. Thanks for quick turnaround! :thumbsup: 

marco_runtime: Filing short postmortem and adding tests to client CI to prevent parallel UUID reuse. I'll attach PRs and monitoring links in the postmortem.

aisha_support: Closing the support ticket after customer confirms. Will follow up with postmortem link.
